CREATE TABLE `game_event_pool` (
  `pool_entry` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Id of the pool',
  `event` smallint(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Put negatives values to remove during event',
